svg.aria-label: One controller, one priority class, seven alerts: 1. Install: Flux installs the controller chart and its CRDs into actions-runner-system with two replicas. 2. Reconcile: The controller reconciles the runner scale sets declared by the two scale-set HelmReleases. 3. Protect: A PriorityClass ranks the controller and listeners above workloads, and a PDB keeps one replica up through drains. 4. Measure: A PodMonitor scrapes controller and listener metrics every 15 seconds, and a Grafana dashboard reads them. 5. Alert: Seven rules cover failure rate, idle runners, a down controller, slow startup, ghost jobs and listener restarts.
